Ava (CustSec): Customer asked for a compact evidence bundle: KMS provenance, RBAC mapping to SCIM, and two sample audit lines (allow + deny) for Splunk ingestion. Need before Wed.
Noah (SecEng): We can do that. Quick Q: do they want full request bodies? recommend redacting payloads.
Priya (Infra): We have key_origin=HSM in metadata and vendor certs. I can export a signed cert PDF and a short key-lifecycle note.
Tom (Solutions): I'll assemble RBAC CSV: columns: principal, role, scim_group, scope, built_in_flag. Mark platform vs tenant roles.
Ava (CustSec): Also include retention policy text and how to request longer exports.
Noah (SecEng): I'll make the sample JSONL audit: fields actor, action, resource, key_id, result, request_id, log_sha. Redact emails.
Priya (Infra): For SIEM mapping I'll add a Splunk HEC example and a tiny Python convert script.
Tom (Solutions): I'll own packaging and README. Plan: send Monday morning with offer for 20-min pre-call.
evidence-bot: Reminder: run `sq-evidence-sanitize --redact-email --redact-ids` before upload.
Ava (CustSec): Perfect. Thanks team.
